text:
Why tell me that? I know: she is changeable,
proud, vain, and capricious;
water will spring from barren rock
before feeling springs from her soul.

I know that in her heart, a nest of snakes,
there is not one fiber that answers love;
that she is a lifeless statue... but...
she is so beautiful!

translation.title: Rhyme XXXIX: Why Tell Me That?
